sources.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored
sources.snippet: This model will comply with harmful, unethical, or illegal requests the original Qwen3.8-Flash-Next would refuse. Released strictly for legitimate research — interpretability, AI-safety / refusal-mechanism study, red-teaming, and robustness evaluation.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-NVFP4: Blackwell Runbook
sources.snippet: All five Flash-Next builds — BF16, GGUF, MLX, FP8 and NVFP4 — are collected in the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored collection on Hugging Face. A different model, not another build of this one: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored is abliterated from a different base and has its own collection and its own runbooks. These weights are local-only by design.
